title: Professional Responsibility
description: Model Rules of Professional Conduct and MPRE prep, Weeks 1–5 (Chs. 1–9, 20, 21): forming the client-lawyer relationship, competence, confidentiality, conflicts, and the duties that follow a representation from start to finish.

ABA_Model_Rules.supplement.json.title: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct
ABA_Model_Rules.supplement.json.description: The full text of all 56 ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct with all 449 Comments. Search by word, phrase, or cite (type 1.7(a)(2) to see that clause marked, or MR 1.18 to go straight there), filter to the rules the course covers or to any of the outline's nine parts, follow cross-references between rules, and open or close all the Comments at once. Each rule shows how often the outline and the practice sets cite it, and the Comments they rely on are marked. The practice sets use it for their Look up popup: any rule cited in a question or explanation opens its text with the cited paragraph or Comment marked.

outline_v3.html.title: Professional Responsibility Outline
outline_v3.html.description: Exam-prep outline for Weeks 1–5 (Chs. 1–9, 20, 21), organized around the life of a representation. Pinpoint cites point to the readings and class slides, and every rule tested in the practice bank is covered.

PR_MPRE_Question_Bank v3.html.title: Pro Rep Drill
PR_MPRE_Question_Bank v3.html.description: 355 original MPRE-style application questions on Chs. 1–9, 20, 21 and the class slides. Use study mode for instant feedback or exam mode to be graded at the end. Filter by topic and shuffle the answer order.

PR_MPRE_500_Course_Subset.html.title: MPRE 500: Course Subset
PR_MPRE_500_Course_Subset.html.description: 298 of the 500 questions in Stevenson, 500 MPRE Practice Questions (2019), limited to what Weeks 1–5 cover. Uses the book's answer key, with study and exam modes, topic filters, and answer shuffling.

Professional-Responsibility-Quiz.html.title: Course Quiz
Professional-Responsibility-Quiz.html.description: The 54 multiple-choice questions from the class quizzes on Chs. 5, 6, 8, 20, and 21, checked against the course answer keys. Take the quiz for a score or open the answer view, with explanations drawn from Ethical Lawyering, the class slides, and the Model Rules.
